dictionary.welcome: Welcome to Choose Your Adventure Game
dictionary.menu: Choose; 1. Create Character or 2. Exit. Type '1' or '2'
dictionary.attack_prompt: Enter 'a' to attack or 'r' to retreat.
dictionary.victory: With the dragon vanquished, you collect the horde of gold, return home, rich and famous. The End.
dictionary.defeat: The dragon laughs as your eyesight fades. You are defeated. Your family mourns their loss. The End.
dictionary.retreat: You quickly retreat. You come home poor but alive to adventure another day. The End.

dictionary.path_prompt_full: You are walking in the mountains. You see three paths. One leads north and higher into the mountains. One leads south and into the woods. One leads west into a narrow canyon. Which do you take? Enter 'n' for North. Enter 's' for South. Enter 'w' for West. Enter 'i' for Inventory. Enter 'e' for exit game.
dictionary.south_path_narrative: You take the South path into the woods. In a quiet clearing you meet a traveling Merchant standing beside a cart full of strange goods.
dictionary.merchant_greeting: The Merchant smiles: 'Brave traveler, the road north is dangerous. Take one of my magical items, free of charge.'
dictionary.merchant_offer: Choose: 1. Magical Armor (every dragon hit does 2 less damage). 2. Magical Weapon (your weapon's maximum damage goes up by 2). 3. Leave. Type 1, 2 or 3.
dictionary.merchant_received_armor: You put on the magical armor. It shimmers faintly. You thank the Merchant and walk back to the crossroads.
dictionary.merchant_received_weapon: The Merchant enchants your weapon. You now carry: {0}. You thank the Merchant and walk back to the crossroads.
dictionary.merchant_leave: You politely decline and walk back to the crossroads.
dictionary.merchant_refusal: The Merchant says: 'You already carry one of my magical items. I cannot give you anything else.' You walk back to the crossroads.
dictionary.west_path_narrative: You take the West path through a narrow canyon. At its end stands an old stone Shrine, half covered in moss.
dictionary.shrine_greeting: A quiet voice fills the air: 'Traveler, you may offer one Prayer here.'
dictionary.shrine_warning: 'Be warned: the gods may bless you, or they may curse you.'
dictionary.shrine_roll: You kneel and pray. The die shows {0}.
dictionary.shrine_blessing: Warm light surrounds you. You are Blessed! You walk back to the crossroads.
dictionary.shrine_nothing: The Shrine stays quiet. Nothing happens. You walk back to the crossroads.
dictionary.shrine_curse: A cold wind cuts through you. You are Cursed! You walk back to the crossroads.
dictionary.shrine_leave: You bow your head, but do not pray, and walk back to the crossroads.
dictionary.shrine_silent: The Shrine is silent. The gods have already answered your Prayer. You walk back to the crossroads.
dictionary.armor_absorbs_blow: Your magical armor absorbs the whole blow!
dictionary.north_path_narrative: You take the North path. After walking for hours, the air grows colder, and the trees become more sparse. You are confronted with a dragon. The dragon has a hoard of gold behind it.
dictionary.dragon_intro: The dragon says 'I am {0}. Leave or perish!'
dictionary.dragon_stats_intro: Your magic ring gives you the stats on the dragon.
dictionary.dragon_encounter_prompt: Do you wish to retreat or attack? Enter 'r' for retreat. Enter 'a' for attack.
dictionary.player_attack_intro: As a {0}, you withdraw your {1} and attack the dragon.
dictionary.dragon_defeated_narrative: With the last words of 'Arggg!', you have defeated the dragon.
dictionary.dragon_defense_taunt_1: Missed me, breath of a gnat!
dictionary.dragon_defense_taunt_2: Is that all you've got? I've seen kittens with more fire in their paws!
dictionary.dragon_defense_taunt_3: Try harder, {0}! You're making me yawn!
dictionary.dragon_defense_taunt_4: Maybe if you squinted harder, you'd actually hit something!
dictionary.dragon_damage_reply_1: Ow! That actually stung a bit!
dictionary.dragon_damage_reply_2: Impressive! You might actually be worth toasting...
dictionary.dragon_damage_reply_3: That... was unexpected. But I assure you, it won't happen again.
dictionary.dragon_damage_reply_4: Well, I'll be! You have more bite than I thought!
